messages.subject: Carpentries Geospatial R Workshop
parts:
The newly finished Carpentries Geospatial R Workshop is coming to Davis!  This 2-day workshop will cover an introduction to R (so no previous R experience is required!) as well as how to work with spatial vector and raster data.  Skilled instructors with lots of R experience will walk you through hands-on examples.  This R-based geospatial workshop will introduce project organization and management for spatial data, cover data structures and storage and transfer formats, teach the creation of summary statistics and publication-quality graphics, and help users work with and plot vector and raster-format spatial data in R.  The enrollment cap is 30 people, so register soon if you’re sure you want to participate.

 

Who? Anyone wanting to get a better understanding of how to use R for geospatial data

When? November 29-30, 2018, from 9:00am to 4:30pm

Where? UC Davis’ Valley Hall, Room 2030

Cost?  $10 to cover materials – if the fee is prohibitive, send me an email

What to bring?  You’ll need to bring a laptop (not a tablet or Chromebook) with the software installed (see the workshop website link below)

 

Register: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/davis-geospatial-data-carpentry-workshop-tickets-51887080655

Workshop Website: https://mikoontz.github.io/2018-11-29-davis-geospatial/

 

Questions?  Email Michele Tobias – mmto...@ucdavis.edu
